evidence: Volume characteristics provide context but do not establish predictive reliability. Some descriptions compare volume during the two declines and the neckline break. Lower reported volume is an observation, not proof of reduced selling conviction or a future rebound. A volume observation does not establish a measured breakout failure rate. RSI divergence is another description of the selected historical data, not evidence of a dramatically higher success rate. If the RSI makes a higher low while price makes an equal or lower low at the second bottom, the oscillator records a smaller decline in its selected inputs; this does not validate a subsequent reversal.
suggestedFix: Describe the observed higher oscillator reading without inferring smaller losses.
